results.content: President Donald Trump's net approval rating has slipped into negative territory in eleven states Trump carried by at least ten points in 2024 — a shift that pushes his political challenges well past the handful of battlegrounds where erosion was already expected. A rolling online survey from Civiqs, built from more than 120,000 responses collected from registered voters since Trump's return to office in January 2025, puts him at 36 percent approval against 59 percent disapproval nationwide as [...] Civiqs is a scientific online polling firm directed by political scientist Drew Linzer and owned by Kos Media. results.title: Trump's Approval Turns Negative in 11 Red States He Won by Double Digits According to Civiqs Online Poll

results.content: Nationally, the president is at 36 percent approval and 59 percent disapproval as of July 30, leaving him significantly underwater with a net approval rating of -24, according to Civiqs’ rolling online tracking poll of registered voters. The poll has garnered more than 120,000 responses since January 20, 2025, when Trump returned to office for a second term.
results.title: Trump’s Approval Rating Is Underwater in 11 States He Won Comfortably
